Book correction: The answer key (Answers 5.1, number 11 (ii)) prints 11x - 11y + 20 = 0. That line has slope +1, so it is parallel to y = x, not perpendicular, and it misses the point of intersection: 11\left(\frac{1}{11}\right) - 11\left(\frac{19}{11}\right) + 20 = 2 \ne 0. The correct answer is 11x + 11y - 20 = 0.
